ideas.title: Following the Money in the Trump Russian Asset Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial ties between Trump and Russian entities, and whether there is any evidence of wrongdoing.
questions: What are the financial ties between Trump and Russian entities?
Is there any evidence of wrongdoing?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant evidence of wrongdoing, and would recommend a thorough financial analysis to determine the extent of the allegations.
